description: Compare a live character's active talent loadout with the most popular build for their spec (Warcraft Logs raid kills and the Mythic+ leaderboards, current raid tier). By default it compares against the spec's overall build (All Dungeons or All Bosses, the best-sampled first); pass content_name and/or difficulty to pick a dungeon or boss. Returns both loadout strings and hero trees, plus the differences: talents only the character has, talents only the popular build has, and rank and choice differences.

content_name.description: Boss or dungeon name (partial match ok), or "All Bosses" / "All Dungeons". Omit for the overall build.

realm.description: Realm name or slug, e.g. "Area 52" or "area-52".

name: compare_character
